name: skill-evaluator
compatibility: Requires Python 3.10+, uv (recommended) or pipx, and access to an LLM agent runtime (Claude Code or Claude API) for spawning isolated evaluation runs.
capabilities: Auto-generate skill-unique challenging test cases from a SKILL.md
Run with-skill / without-skill / version-vs-version A/B benchmarks
Grade outputs with hybrid programmatic + LLM-judge assertions
Aggregate pass-rate, token, latency benchmarks with mean ± stddev
Detect regression across iterations (hard, case, cost, blind)
Propose lean, regression-safe improvements grounded in transcripts
Optimize the trigger description with train/validation splits
constraints: Workspace artifacts live outside the skill directory
Never modify a skill's SKILL.md automatically without --apply-proposals
